title: Introduce language-aware presubmit proxy and dependency quietifier
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: Presubmit pipelines are noisy for polyglot changes and third-party dependency churn. This PR introduces a lightweight presubmit proxy that routes lint/test jobs to language-aware shards and a "dependency quietifier" that gates irrelevant transitive dep churn from triggering full-language presubmit lanes. Goals: reduce noisy presubmit runs, speed feedback for common changes, and provide a reversible rollout path.

What changed: implemented a presubmit proxy service (thin Go binary) that reads the change set and consults a language mapping table to select a subset of presubmit shards. Added a dependency quietifier heuristic that: (1) detects if changes only touch vendor/lockfile metadata or deeply transitive packages, (2) marks the PR with a "deps:quiet" signal to bypass full test lanes, and (3) emits telemetry for false-positive/false-negative analysis. Integrated the proxy as an optional step in the GitHub Actions presubmit workflow.

Key behaviors: - Language mapping is configurable per-team via .ci/language-mapping.yaml - Quietifier runs inside the presubmit proxy and is tunable via thresholds/.ci/quietifier-config.yaml - Non-blocking: by default the proxy only *suggests* lanes; when enabled via repo-level opt-in it becomes authoritative for presubmit selection - Telemetry: emits presubmit_selection, quietifier_decision, and presubmit_savings metrics to the existing CI telemetry pipeline.

Testing and rollout: unit tests for Go module, integration harness that runs a dry-presubmit against a snapshot of the monorepo (see tests/integration/presubmit_proxy/). Staged rollout: opt-in on a few low-risk teams for 1 week, monitor presubmit_savings and CI latency, then expand. A quick revert commit is included to disable the proxy if we see regressions.

Checklist:
- [x] implement proxy binary and unit tests
- [x] add language mapping and default rules for main languages (Go, Python, TypeScript, Rust)
- [x] wire proxy into GitHub Actions presubmit workflow with opt-in flag
- [x] add telemetry hooks and dashboards (draft)
- [x] smoke-tested with 10 representative PRs

Notes: This PR intentionally avoids changing existing lint/test jobs themselves and focuses on selection/routing. Follow-ups: a) refine quietifier heuristics to use dependency graph reachability (ENG-2401), b) add an author/owner override for critical fixes, c) expand language mapping coverage for smaller languages. Related: Linear ENG-2345 for presubmit cost-savings target, SUP-1123 incident that motivated noisy dependency churn mitigation.

merge_commit_message:
Introduce language-aware presubmit proxy and dependency quietifier (squash)

Implements opt-in presubmit selection, quietifier heuristics, telemetry.

Related: ENG-2345, SUP-1123
release_notes: Add optional language-aware presubmit proxy to reduce unnecessary full-lane CI runs; a dependency quietifier that can suppress CI for low-risk transitive dep churn. Opt-in rollout; monitor presubmit_savings metric.
notes_for_ops: To enable authoritative mode set repo setting ci.presubmit.proxy=enabled and configure .ci/language-mapping.yaml. Telemetry prefix: ci.presubmit_proxy.*. If rollback needed, merge the provided revert commit or flip repo setting to disabled.
